Connor —

Attached is a formal notice that a third party has alleged IP infringement related to the 'CatalogSync' integration we use with Redwood. Our legal team asked me to send this to your legal/ops contact and also to procurement so we can get evidence and insurance information circulated quickly.

Attachment: claim_notice.pdf (pdf) — official notice from complainant counsel.

Can you confirm who will be the internal owner for evidence and whether Redwood will engage its insurance/defense per the Order Form? Procurement wants a timeline for when Globe can expect a response to the notice and a copy of your insurance declarations.
